animate_camera.authorization: Planning only: this tool updates the in-memory scene specification. It must not write the database, touch storage, download media, render, or publish.
animate_camera.behavior: Validate the target, timing window, camera constraints and easing type; convert relative times to frames from the real scene duration; generate camera keyframes on the specification; return the generated motionId. A hold may use a zero-length window with easing='hold'. Prefer startS/endS, startFrac/endFrac, or line anchors — do not compute frames.
animate_camera.defaults: easing defaults to ease_in_out; rot defaults to 0.

errors.INVALID_RANGE: Use a positive frame interval, or easing='hold' for a still camera.
errors.MISSING_TARGET: Place the focus target first, or omit focusTargetId.

apply_effect.authorization: Planning only: this tool updates the in-memory scene specification. It must not write the database, touch storage, download media, render, or publish.
